description:
Proposal approved 2026-11-08: https://claude.ai/artifact/L6gtoTpK5ad6MoUM1qV3py (research in session scratchpad p16/slow/proposal.md, probes s0-s5, h_*, g_*, f1, f2, widen.py).

Why. A literal atom is its own type and nothing erases it from an activation key, so one OptionParser.parse call mints 17 activations of Kernel.===/2 that differ only in which atoms they compare and all return boolean (one call: 2912 jobs, 316 activations over 142 functions, 1231 lowered native fns; fixture 00765: 854 activations, ===/2 73, Enum.member?/2 56, List.member?/2 46, Keyword.get/3 29). CI on #286/#287 is red because OptionParser rows exceed the fixture matrix's 20 s hang guard on the debug build. Only atoms (bool and nil included, and composites holding them) fan out; the lattice has no numeric or binary singletons (literal_ty, int_lit ignores its value, Binary is str). Closure brands are the already-erased sibling (erase_transported_closure_identities, fz-6gb).

Rule. A key position keeps an identity-bearing literal iff some use of that position can tell it from another literal of its kind: an entry-dispatch question that mentions a literal (or whose type does), an if or guard that reads it, a callee that does transitively, or the position is returned; any use the analysis cannot see counts. Everywhere else the literal widens to its kind, recursively through structure, and the structure is left exactly as it was.

Where. Two coupled edits on the one existing data path. (1) DispatchDemand gains Class between Ignore and the shape demands (Class ⊔ shape = shape, Class ⊔ Whole = Whole); demand_for_region (src/dispatch_matrix/mod.rs ~1217) decides: Type(T) → Class iff widen_literals(T) == T, Equal(Const(g)) → Class iff g holds no atom, Guard/MapKind/MapKeyPresent/Bitstring/Equal(Pinned) stay Whole; a protocol receiver (jobs/keying.rs ~581) is Class iff every impl target is literal-blind. (2) convergence_collapse_ty (types/mod.rs ~1752) widens literals under Class and Ignore via one new memoized idempotent monotone Types::widen_literals (finite atom sets → atom, recursive, distributes over union); returned axis consulted first as now. canonical_activation_key_inner (world.rs ~2334) applies the same per-slot function on both paths (non-recursive: literals only, structure untouched, absorbing the closure-brand erasure as the other half of one function); probe_keys_as_itself gains widen_literals(a) == a so atom rows reach the demand facts. Prerequisite: the demand derivation classifies EVERY use of an input-derived value (use table on the page: DirectCall arg whole or projected with path → callee demand lifted by path; If condition, ClosureCall callee/arg, lambda capture, constructions → Whole; BinaryOp/UnaryOp operand, MapIndex literal key → Class; anything not listed → Whole); forwarded_inputs stops filtering path.is_empty(). Decided: the coarse Class/Whole lattice, not a set-valued atom demand. The closure-brand erasure folds into the same function; no separate nominal-brand ticket exists on this board.

Predicted (simulation, upper bound of saving): s1 316 → ~240, s4 42 → 12, s5 43 → 41, 00765 854 → 320..354, corpus 16837 → 14198..14461 with 475 fixtures unchanged, quicksort unchanged. The remainder on s1 is list element-type rungs across the reduce cycle: fz-y5x, not this ticket. CI margin is not promised; debug-build time of 00758-00770 is measured in the ticket. Pins predicted lower: 00420, 00571, 00277, 00183, 00230, 00419, 00418, 00384. Risk of rise (report, never re-bless): DeriveInputDemand/DeriveRecursive counts and waits for atom-only-row callers, more rows per first analysis. Tests, removal ledger, docs and the telemetry event fz.compiler2.activation_key.literal_widened are on the page. Lands on top of stack #274 after fz-sc8.97 and fz-sc8.8.
title: An activation key names only the literals a use can tell apart
